entries.category_description: Supply of goods and services of a kind normally intended for use in agricultural production but excluding capital goods such as machinery or buildings
Supply of goods and services of a kind normally intended for use in agricultural production but excluding capital goods such as machinery or buildings
entries.comment: Fertilization; Ploughing; Harrowing; Preparing the seedbed with combine and moulding soil; Seed sowing or planting; Land rolling; Spraying, dusting - fight diseases and pests, herbicide; Harvesting or crop dislocation; Collecting and baling the vegetal material, by pressing in bales; Hoeing crops; Pots planting for potatoes and vegetables. For details see art. 291 para. (2) lett. e) of the Fiscal Code and points 1 - 7, 9, 10, 12, 15 of the Annex to the Order no. 4634/2022.

entries.category_description: Supply of goods and services of a kind normally intended for use in agricultural production but excluding capital goods such as machinery or buildings
entries.comment: The reduced rate shall be applied for Mowing; Raking; Digging holes for planting trees and vines; Cleaning of unwanted vegetation and destruction of heaps on pastures and hayfields; Meadow overseeding; Planting horticultural grape vines, trees; Deforestation of vineyards and orchards; Installation of support, growing and palisade system for vineyards and orchards. See art. 291 para. (2) letter e) of the Fiscal Code and points 18, 19, 23, 27, 28, 35 - 37 of the Annex to the Order no. 4634/2022.
